meta_description: Compose a custom wedding crest in under a minute. Six styles, twelve layouts, eight typography pairings.
title: Create your wedding crest
description: Tell us about your day and we will compose a one-of-a-kind crest.
invalid_hex: Please enter a valid hex color (e.g. #a4b6a0)
personal_elements_hint: Add up to 2 personal details (e.g. a beloved pet, monogram, family crest).
personal_image_upload_hint: Upload up to 2 photos (a pet, a place, an object). We'll paint the main subject into your crest in the chosen style.
personal_image_max_reached: You can attach up to 2 reference photos.
personal_image_upload_error: Couldn't upload that photo. Try a JPG, PNG, or WEBP under 10MB.
preview_note: The illustration is a name-free background; the program adds names and date on top.
preview_no_photo: No example photos for this style yet — your crest will be drawn from the style description.
lettering_follows_example_hint: Lettering style will follow your example (or the style default if you started from scratch).
generate_hint: Paid generation · Unlimited regenerations for one week
submit_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
edit_description: Change anything from the create steps. We'll regenerate the crest with the new choices and keep your previous generations in history.
edit_load_error: Couldn't load your project. Head back to /my-designs and try again.
border_hint: Pick a frame from the studio library — or skip this to keep the crest borderless.
border_empty: No borders available for this style yet.
start_from_example_hint: Tap any crest to load its style, colors, and layout — you can swap your names in next.
daily_limit: Image generation resources are busy. Please try again tomorrow. Your designs are saved.
access_expired: Your generation access has expired. Purchase again to continue. Your designs are saved.
payment_required: Purchase your image pack to start generating.
location_usage_hint: Scene inspiration affects the illustration without printing these words. Print mode adds the exact place names as text and keeps the scene unchanged.
purchase_access_lost: Purchase access could not be recovered in this browser. Keep this page and contact support with your payment receipt; do not pay again.
draft_storage_error: Your draft could not be saved. Enable browser storage before continuing to payment.
payment_unconfirmed: Payment is not confirmed yet. Your draft is saved. Check again shortly; no new payment or image request has been made.
payment_canceled: Payment was canceled. Your draft is saved and you can continue whenever you are ready.
payment_failed: The payment was not confirmed. Your draft is saved. Check your payment receipt before trying again.
receipt_email_missing: Payment succeeded, but the payment provider did not return an email address. Your designs remain unlocked. You may optionally add a contact email; this does not create a login.
receipt_email_saved: Contact email saved. Your designs remain unlocked.
receipt_email_error: The email could not be saved. Your paid access is unchanged; try again later.
checkout_ended_retry: This checkout has ended. Your draft is saved. Click again to start a new checkout.
checkout_initializing_retry: Your checkout is still preparing. Your draft is saved. Please retry shortly.
